mapper.sql: SELECT a.appointment_no, a.status, a.booked_via, a.booked_at, a.slot_id, ds.id AS schedule_id, ds.schedule_date, ds.clinic_period, s.start_at, s.end_at, a.checked_in_at, a.cancelled_at, ds.status AS schedule_status, s.status AS slot_status, d.status AS department_status, dr.status AS doctor_status, a.department_id, d.name AS department_name, a.doctor_id, dr.name AS doctor_name, dr.title AS doctor_title, original.appointment_no AS original_no, replacement.appointment_no AS replacement_no, stop.public_reason, stop.occurred_at AS stopped_at, impact.outcome, impact.arrangement, patient.display_name AS patient_display_name, a.visited_at, review.id AS visit_review_id, review.outcome AS reviewed_outcome, review.reviewed_at

FROM appointment a JOIN appointment_slot s ON s.id = a.slot_id JOIN doctor_schedule ds ON ds.id = s.schedule_id JOIN department d ON d.id = a.department_id JOIN doctor dr ON dr.id = a.doctor_id JOIN sys_user patient ON patient.id=a.patient_id LEFT JOIN appointment original ON original.id = a.rescheduled_from_id AND original.patient_id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN appointment replacement ON replacement.rescheduled_from_id = a.id AND replacement.patient_id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN interrupted_appointment impact ON impact.appointment_id=a.id LEFT JOIN schedule_interruption stop ON stop.schedule_id=impact.schedule_id LEFT JOIN appointment_visit_review review ON review.id=( SELECT MAX(r.id) FROM appointment_visit_review r WHERE r.appointment_id=a.id )
a.status = 'INTERRUPTED' AND impact.appointment_id IS NOT NULL AND impact.outcome IS NULL
WHERE a.patient_id = #{patientId} AND NOT ((a.status='BOOKED' AND s.end_at > #{now}) OR (a.status='CHECKED_IN' AND ds.schedule_date >= #{today}))

mapper.sql: FROM operation_audit_log audit LEFT JOIN sys_user staff ON audit.operator_type = 'ADMIN' AND staff.id = audit.operator_id LEFT JOIN interrupted_appointment impact ON impact.appointment_id=audit.target_id LEFT JOIN schedule_interruption stop ON stop.schedule_id=impact.schedule_id LEFT JOIN appointment_visit_review review ON review.audit_operation_no=audit.operation_no WHERE audit.target_type = 'APPOINTMENT' AND (audit.target_id = #{target.id} OR (audit.target_id = #{target.originalId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND audit.operation_type = 'APPOINTMENT_RESCHEDULE' AND audit.result_status = 'SUCCEEDED'))
mapper.select:
SELECT audit.created_at, audit.operation_type, audit.operator_type, staff.display_name, audit.result_status, audit.result_code, CASE WHEN audit.operation_type='APPOINTMENT_INTERRUPTED' THEN stop.public_reason WHEN audit.operation_type='APPOINTMENT_ARRANGED' THEN impact.arrangement WHEN audit.operation_type='APPOINTMENT_VISIT_REVIEW' THEN CONCAT(IF(review.outcome='CONFIRMED','确认已就诊','结果待核实'), ' · ', review.reason) END AS public_note
ORDER BY audit.created_at DESC, audit.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
